svg.title: etcd
svg.desc: etcd. A strongly consistent key-value store on Raft that clusters use for configuration, service discovery, locks and leader election. Step 1, Where it sits: Every Kubernetes object is a key in etcd; only the API server talks to it. 3 members, one per AZ. Step 2, A write through Raft: Leader etcd-1 appends entry 52340 in term 7; with 2 of 3 on disk it commits as revision 41872. Step 3, Watches and leases: A watch streams the change to the controllers; a Txn on mod_revision hands the Lease to scheduler-b. Step 4, Failure and limits: etcd-1 fails; etcd-2 wins term 8 and 2 of 3 still commit. Limits: 2 GiB quota, disk, compaction.

g.text: Every Kubernetes object is a key in etcd; only the API server talks to it. 3 members, one per AZ.
Leader etcd-1 appends entry 52340 in term 7; with 2 of 3 on disk it commits as revision 41872.
A watch streams the change to the controllers; a Txn on mod_revision hands the Lease to scheduler-b.
etcd-1 fails; etcd-2 wins term 8 and 2 of 3 still commit. Limits: 2 GiB quota, disk, compaction.
the only Kubernetes component that should reach etcd
Txn: if mod_revision = 41880, put holder scheduler-b
etcd-1 unreachable: the client switches to etcd-2
term 8: asks etcd-3 for its vote
Every Kubernetes object (Deployments, Pods, Leases, Secrets) is a key under /registry/ in etcd, and only kube-apiserver talks to it.
Three members, one per Availability Zone, survive one failure; Kubernetes recommends five in production.
The API server sends a Txn (if mod_revision = 41250, put) to the leader etcd-1, which appends entry 52340 in term 7 and sends it on.
With 2 of 3 on disk the entry is committed: etcd-1 applies it as revision 41872 and answers; followers apply it on the next heartbeat.
The API server watches /registry/deployments/ from a revision, so the change arrives as an event and the controllers react at once.
The scheduler Lease is an ordinary key: 15 s after scheduler-a's last renewal, scheduler-b takes it with a Txn on mod_revision.
etcd-1 fails: when etcd-2's election timeout (1 s by default) runs out, it wins term 8 with etcd-3's vote. Lose two: no writes.
